contractCases.expected: The wrapper is exactly a native textarea with React.ComponentProps<textarea>. value/defaultValue, name, required, disabled, readOnly, maxLength, rows and onChange are native props. It adds field-sizing-content and a minimum height, not autosave, rich text, a submit-on-Enter handler or a new value callback.

Native multiline editing and IME apply. Enter inserts a newline, Tab leaves the control, Escape does not revert committed text. Disabled suppresses editing and native form submission; readOnly permits focus/copy and retains its submitted value. Caller owns validation and explicit error relations.
